public.text: Reusability “without modification to its core design” may be unrealistic. Shared components often require configurable workflows, jurisdictional extensions, localisation, terminology bindings, and deployment-specific security controls.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with a statement like: “Reusable across multiple programmes and use cases without changes that compromise its core function, public interfaces, or conformance obligations.”
